title: The Crystal Conservatory
template:
Hidden behind the hills lies a conservatory made of crystal. Every leaf and petal is crafted from [material]. The sunlight hits the glass, creating a spectrum of colors. Visitors must walk softly to avoid breaking the delicate atmosphere.

In the center stands a towering [plant_type] that glows at dusk. Its branches are adorned with [color] glass bells. When the wind blows, they make a sound like a quiet chime.

To nurture these fragile creations, the gardeners use [liquid]. This substance keeps the glass clear and shimmering. A small [animal] made of sapphire flits between the frozen blossoms.

The air inside smells faintly like [scent]. It is a place where time seems to stand perfectly still. Leaving the garden feels like waking from a [type_of_dream]. One always carries a piece of that light home in their heart.

blanks.hint: a type of plant or tree
